notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
easyPrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ioreth of the Healing House is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.
